ActivityFailureCode.description:
The allowlisted technical failure codes an ``activity.failed`` may
report.  Normal judgments (no match, unreadable pages, missing scope)
are completions, never failures.
ActivityFailureCode.title: ActivityFailureCode

ActivityStatus.description:
The allowlisted sub-state of a still-running Activity.

Distinct from the terminal outcome: an ``updated`` event may report the
work is ``in_progress``, ``waiting`` on a resource, or visibly
``retrying`` after a semantic (non-transport) retry.  Transient transport
redelivery is not a status — it reuses the same event ID instead.
ActivityStatus.title: ActivityStatus

AssetUnderstandingCompleted.description:
Completes with the final measured counts and an optional normal
judgment.  ``scope_required``/``unreadable_pages`` are completions —
technical failures are ``failed`` events instead.
AssetUnderstandingCompleted.title: AssetUnderstandingCompleted

AssetUnderstandingOutcome.description: Normal (non-failure) completion judgments of asset understanding.
AssetUnderstandingOutcome.title: AssetUnderstandingOutcome

AssetUnderstandingReason.description: Why an asset_understanding Activity runs (plan/20-21 allowlist).
AssetUnderstandingReason.title: AssetUnderstandingReason

AssetUnderstandingStarted.description:
Starts one measured pass over declared targets.  ``reason`` and
``targets`` define the attempt: a different reason or page set is a
different Activity, not an update of this one.
AssetUnderstandingStarted.title: AssetUnderstandingStarted

AssistantResponseV1.description:
A completed public answer: ordered 1-depth pages plus a source catalog.

The catalog lists every source reference inline markers may cite;
a marker naming a missing entry is a dangling reference and rejected,
and page ranges of the same asset may not overlap.  ``Candidate``
content, verification internals, and Server-derived fields
(``display_label_snapshot``, ``available``, ``plain_text``) are not
representable here.
AssistantResponseV1.title: AssistantResponseV1

AttachmentFailureReason.description:
The public sub-code an ``invalid_attachment`` failure carries.

The literal set mirrors
:class:`~proovy_brain.features.multimodal_input.validation.AttachmentRejectionReason`
exactly — the same relationship ``RunCanceledPayload.cause`` keeps
with ``CancelCause`` — so every safe file-inspection refusal owns one
wire spelling and one fixed message.  The wire enum is its own
declaration, not an import: an internal rename or a new rejection
reason can never silently change the published vocabulary; extending
it is a deliberate, fixture-versioned contract change.
AttachmentFailureReason.title: AttachmentFailureReason

CheckBlock.description:
The check of a user-submitted solution.

``step_marks`` carry the per-step verdict on the user's work —
``failed`` marks are legitimate here — and ``first_error_step_id``
highlights the earliest failed step.  ``quoted_spans`` mark which body
regions quote the user's submission; Brain-generated candidate text may
never be quoted.
CheckBlock.title: CheckBlock

ClaimVerificationSummary.description: One claim's public coverage; never the internal report itself.
ClaimVerificationSummary.title: ClaimVerificationSummary

ClarificationReason.description: The allowlisted reasons a clarification-only response may carry.
ClarificationReason.title: ClarificationReason

CodeExecutionCompleted.description:
A clean exit is an execution result only — never a claim that any
mathematics was verified.
CodeExecutionCompleted.title: CodeExecutionCompleted

CodeExecutionStarted.description:
A code execution outside a verification round.  Inside verification,
executions are reported as the verification Activity's status instead —
a separate code_execution Activity is never emitted there.
CodeExecutionStarted.title: CodeExecutionStarted

ExplanationBlock.description: An explanation; optionally a re-expression of a Verified Solution.
ExplanationBlock.title: ExplanationBlock

LimitedPage.description: One named page in a bounded ``note_retrieval`` result list.
LimitedPage.title: LimitedPage

ModelTier.description: Logical model tier selected by the caller.
ModelTier.title: ModelTier

NoteRetrievalCompleted.description:
Completes with the allowlisted match status and a bounded page list.
``limited_pages_unresolved`` must name the pages it could not resolve,
``no_relevant_content`` must name none, and ``conflicting_content`` may
name the conflicting pages (plan/21).  A no-match or unresolved result
carries empty answer provenance on the terminal contract (owned by the
response side, not this payload).
NoteRetrievalCompleted.title: NoteRetrievalCompleted

NoteRetrievalMatchStatus.description:
Normal (non-failure) retrieval outcomes; absence of a match or a
conflict is a completed retrieval, not an error.
NoteRetrievalMatchStatus.title: NoteRetrievalMatchStatus

NoticeBlock.description: A notice about a mixed or partially unsupported request.
NoticeBlock.title: NoticeBlock

PagePresentation.description: How a response page attaches to the message; pages never nest.
PagePresentation.title: PagePresentation

PageTarget.description:
One asset page range an ``asset_understanding`` Activity works on.
Pages are 1-based and inclusive.
PageTarget.title: PageTarget

QuoteOrigin.description:
Where a quoted span comes from.

``BRAIN_CANDIDATE`` exists so the publication assembly can classify its
internal spans; public blocks reject it — a rejected or uncommitted
Brain candidate is never quotable content.
QuoteOrigin.title: QuoteOrigin

QuotedSpan.description:
A region of the block body quoted from an external origin.

Only ``user_submission`` may appear in a public response: a check block
may quote the user's own erroneous work, while Brain-generated candidate
text is never quotable.
QuotedSpan.title: QuotedSpan

ResponseDisposition.description: Terminal response classification; the typed input 1.26 validates.
ResponseDisposition.title: ResponseDisposition

RichTextBlock.description: Bounded free text: notices, clarifications, unsupported guidance.
RichTextBlock.title: RichTextBlock

SolutionBlock.description:
A Brain-authored solution with an explicit verification display.

``solution_id`` references the immutable Verified Solution this block
publishes.  A ``verified``/``partially_verified`` block requires it; an
``unverified`` (inconclusive) block forbids it — an unverified solution
is never a Verified Solution.  A published solution can never carry a
``failed`` mark: a confirmed step failure means the candidate was
rejected, and rejected candidates are not public.
SolutionBlock.title: SolutionBlock

SolutionVerificationSummary.description:
One solution's public verification summary on the terminal payload.

``overall_coverage`` is ``supporting`` whenever any claim is supporting —
the summary may never present partial confirmation as complete
verification.
SolutionVerificationSummary.title: SolutionVerificationSummary

SourceReference.description:
The Brain-owned half of a source catalog entry.

``display_label_snapshot`` and ``available`` are Server-derived
presentation values and deliberately absent here; the browser serializer
injects them explicitly.  Pages are 1-based and inclusive.
SourceReference.title: SourceReference

StepMark.description:
One Solution Step's public status mark on a block.

``anchor`` locates the step inside this block's public body; it is absent
when the step's span is not publicly shown, so a mark can never point at
hidden content.  ``reason`` is a safe, bounded explanation — required for
``unconfirmed`` so an unchecked step always says why.
StepMark.title: StepMark

StepMarkStatus.description: The public per-step verification mark (wire values).
StepMarkStatus.title: StepMarkStatus

StepProgress.description:
Measured progress of one verification round: ``checked`` of ``total``
Solution Steps.  Counts are caller-measured; this model never fabricates
a percentage and never carries step content or verdicts.
StepProgress.title: StepProgress

SummaryCoverage.description: Coverage levels the public verification summary may report.
SummaryCoverage.title: SummaryCoverage

TextAnchor.description:
A ``[start, end)`` code-point range into a block's stored public body.

Offsets are deterministic over repeated text, math, and Unicode because
they index the stored string rather than searching for a substring.
Consumers on UTF-16 platforms (Java/JavaScript) convert units
themselves.  An anchor can only ever point at public body text — it
cannot reference a hidden or internal span by construction.
TextAnchor.title: TextAnchor

UnconfirmedStepSummary.description: A step the verifier could not confirm, with a safe reason.
UnconfirmedStepSummary.title: UnconfirmedStepSummary

VerificationBadge.description:
The response's honest verification display (ADR 0011).

``VERIFIED`` — every Answer-bearing Claim reached direct coverage.
``PARTIALLY_VERIFIED`` — accepted with supporting coverage; some steps
were confirmed by numeric check or review instead of an exact check.
``UNVERIFIED`` — inconclusive: published with the unverified display and
unconfirmed marks, and never carries a Verified Solution reference.
VerificationBadge.title: VerificationBadge

VerificationStarted.description:
One verifier round.  Per-step verdicts and step content are not
representable — they surface only as terminal Result Block marks.
VerificationStarted.title: VerificationStarted
